evals.name: Multi-Stream Plan Execution with Source URL Provenance
evals.prompt: Execute evidence research for a ResearchPlan containing two streams: RS-001 (inventory sync) and RS-002 (courier handoff). Collect real practitioner signals across available adapters.
evals.expected_output: Allocates deterministic query task IDs (RS-001-Q001, RS-002-Q001), executes queries across available adapters, records permanent source URLs and retrieval timestamps, and preserves raw query links without fabricating synthetic findings.
assertions: Allocates deterministic task IDs preserving stream identifiers
Records permanent source URLs and retrieval timestamps
Preserves original query strings and provider-adapted variants
Formats output conforming to research-signals.schema.json

evals.name: Provider Failure & Timeout Isolation without False Zero Hits
evals.prompt: Simulate search execution where GitHub Issues API returns HTTP 500 server error and Web Search adapter is unconfigured.
evals.expected_output: Records GitHub provider run as FAILED with error message, marks Web Search as SKIPPED_UNAVAILABLE, sets overall status to COMPLETED_WITH_GAPS, and strictly avoids interpreting provider failures as zero search results.
assertions: Marks unconfigured adapter as SKIPPED_UNAVAILABLE
Records API server error as FAILED rather than zero hits
Sets overall run status to COMPLETED_WITH_GAPS
Logs explicit gaps in research_limitations array

evals.name: Source Inspection State Classification
evals.prompt: Process two search hits where Hit A allows full page review, while Hit B is blocked by a login wall.
evals.expected_output: Tags Hit A with inspection_status FULL_SOURCE_REVIEWED, tags Hit B as INACCESSIBLE, preserves Hit B snippet without fabricating full-thread findings, and marks primary verification as pending.
assertions: Applies FULL_SOURCE_REVIEWED to accessible content
Applies INACCESSIBLE to login-gated content
Refrains from hallucinating details for inaccessible URLs
Labels community post observations as L3 evidence

evals.name: Canonical Source Deduplication across Query Tasks
evals.prompt: Execute search where both RS-001-Q001 and RS-001-Q002 retrieve the exact same Reddit thread URL.
evals.expected_output: Creates a single canonical signal record in signals array, links both RS-001-Q001 and RS-001-Q002 in query_ids, and ensures the single post is not counted as two independent sources.
assertions: Collapses duplicate URL hits into a single canonical signal
Associates all matching query_ids in the signal record
Prevents artificial inflation of corroborating source counts
Maintains complete raw_result_ids audit trail

evals.name: SQLite Evidence Persistence Contract Verification
evals.prompt: Persist collected evidence signals into the SQLite database for research run RUN-2026-001.
evals.expected_output: Batch inserts signals into evidence_signals table ensuring candidate_id is NULL, populates signal_id and raw JSON payloads, and executes stage update on research_runs to RESEARCHED.
assertions: Inserts signals into evidence_signals table with candidate_id NULL
Populates stream_id, platform, source_url, and evidence_level
Updates research_runs current_stage to RESEARCHED
Emits claim-check confirmation to stderr
